stem: Which sentence should replace sentence 31 to bring this paper to a more effective conclusion?

options.label: A
options.text: Given these facts, it is likely that urban heat islands are going to be part of our world for many years to come.

options.label: B
options.text: Obviously, it is important that we do our part to safeguard our cities and to make them desirable places to live and work.

options.label: C
options.text: Fortunately, awareness of the problem of urban heat islands is encouraging new practices designed to make life in cities better for all.

options.label: D
options.text: In response, city inhabitants are caring for more and more trees around and throughout urban areas.
